turns.question: Which customer country cancelled the biggest share of its orders between 17 August and 30 September 2026, and what share?
turns.answer: Customer country US (United States) cancelled the biggest share of its orders: 13.3% (2 of 15 orders) over 17 August to 30 September 2026, 45 days. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which country cancelled the smallest share?
turns.answer: Customer country GB (United Kingdom) cancelled the smallest share: 6.1% (2 of 33 orders) over the same 17 August to 30 September 2026 period, 45 days. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
